style_instructions: Write idiomatic, polished German for a senior technology CV.
Prefer concise active phrasing and established German professional usage over literal word-for-word translation.
Retain English industry terms when they are more natural or precise in German technology hiring contexts.
Use implied first person without personal pronouns in profile and achievement text.
Preserve factual scope, tense, dates, numbers, ownership and certainty; never strengthen a claim during translation.
Technical terms: choose a natural sounding translation that reflects the common use of English terminology, rather than a more linguistically correct approach
avoid_terms: Lieferleistung as a literal translation of delivery performance
Lieferung as a literal translation of engineering delivery
Software-Ingenieur when Softwareentwickler or Softwareentwicklung is more natural
literal English calques that sound unnatural in a German CV
notes: This file is a living project glossary. Edit it when a translation needs a preferred term or a recurring correction.
The guidance is sent to the configured OpenRouter model with each translation request.
